meta.subject: bug fix: busy signal should wait for all intrs to complete

en.summary: Fixes core busy generation so the core stays busy until already-issued instructions fully commit, not just until no warp remains schedulable.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly describes a busy-signal hardware bug.
The RTL fix adds retire feedback and changes the actual busy predicate.
Busy deassertion is observable DUT control behavior and affects completion detection.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes unrelated RTL, runtime, and simulator changes.
evidence: VX_commit.sv adds cmt_to_fetch_if to report fully committed instructions.
VX_fetch.sv and VX_core.sv route that feedback into the fetch-side scheduler.
VX_warp_sched.sv adds pending_instrs and changes busy to active_warps != 0 || pending_instrs != 0.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A core can stop scheduling new work before all previously issued instructions retire. If busy depends only on active warp or fetch state, the core can look idle while commit is still draining in-flight instructions.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The last active warp becomes idle while older instructions are still in later pipeline stages and have not emitted their final commit event.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop retire-to-front-end accounting and compute busy only from active warp or scheduler-visible work.
portability_notes: Apply this to any core whose busy signal is observed by host code or outer control logic.
The reusable bug is missing accounting for in-flight work after scheduling stops.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the signal or counter that determines core busy.
Remove any increment-on-issue and decrement-on-final-commit feedback path.
Change busy to depend only on active warps or fetch activity.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: busy generation and pending-instruction accounting between commit and warp scheduler
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds commit-to-fetch feedback, counts final commits, tracks pending instructions, and keeps busy asserted until both active warps and pending work are zero.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove cmt_to_fetch_if plumbing and revert VX_warp_sched busy generation to active_warps-only behavior.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The core busy signal deasserts too early, so host or outer control logic can observe completion before all older instructions retire.
evidence_for_injection: The new interface exists only to pass committed-count feedback from commit to fetch.
pending_instrs increments on schedule_fire and decrements on committed feedback.
The pre-fix busy expression depended only on active_warps.
notes: Keep the mutation centered on busy generation.
Even if architectural results eventually become correct, completion timing becomes wrong.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 core busy 信号的生成逻辑，使 core 只有在已发射指令全部最终提交后才撤销 busy，而不是仅在没有可调度 warp 时就撤销。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确描述了 busy 信号硬件缺陷。
RTL 修复新增了退休反馈，并直接修改了 busy 判定。
busy 的撤销时机属于可观察 DUT 控制行为，会影响完成检测。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含其他无关的 RTL、runtime 和 simulator 改动。
evidence: VX_commit.sv 新增 cmt_to_fetch_if 来报告真正完成提交的指令数量。
VX_fetch.sv 和 VX_core.sv 把这条反馈接入 fetch 侧调度器。
VX_warp_sched.sv 增加 pending_instrs，并把 busy 改成 active_warps != 0 || pending_instrs != 0。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个 core 可能已经停止调度新工作，但仍有更早发射的指令尚未退休完成。如果 busy 只看 active warp 或 fetch 状态，core 就可能在 commit 仍在排空时被错误地看成空闲。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 基于退休侧未完成工作统计的 busy 生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 最后一个 active warp 已经空闲，但更早指令仍停留在后级流水线中，尚未发出最终 commit。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除 retire 到前端的统计反馈，让 busy 重新只依赖 active warp 或调度器可见工作。
portability_notes: 适用于任何 busy 信号会被 host 或外层控制逻辑观察的 core。
可复用缺陷的本质是调度停止后缺少对飞行中工作的统计。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定 core busy 的信号或计数器。
删除 issue 加一、final commit 减一的反馈路径。
把 busy 改成只依赖 active warp 或 fetch 活动。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: commit 与 warp scheduler 之间的 busy 生成和未完成指令计数
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增 commit-to-fetch 反馈、统计最终 commit、跟踪 pending instructions，并且只有在 active warps 和 pending work 都清零时才撤销 busy。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 cmt_to_fetch_if 连线，并把 VX_warp_sched 的 busy 逻辑恢复成只看 active_warps。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: core busy 会过早撤销，导致 host 或外层控制逻辑在所有旧指令退休完成之前就观测到完成。
evidence_for_injection: 新增接口的唯一作用就是把 committed-count 从 commit 传回 fetch。
pending_instrs 在 schedule_fire 时加一，在 committed 反馈时减相应数量。
修复前的 busy 表达式只依赖 active_warps。
notes: 注入时应聚焦在 busy 生成逻辑。
即使最终架构结果正确，完成时序也会错误。
